fields.label: Statement
fields.text: Treat P03 Lemmas 2–3 + Thm 1 (and P04 eqs.(19)–(23), P05 Thm 1) as *fixed, cited* constraints and search the free parameters (γ_det, γ_err, ν_cor, ν_unf, N, δ_h, δ_d) to minimise resource cost at fixed ε. Report the gap against each paper's published tuple. *Possible measured increment:* e.g. smaller N at the same ε than P03's hand-tuned Fig.5 choices. This must be shown numerically and independently re-checked. If the gain is negligible, report that.
